content.text:
* Low-noise PMOS LDO, matched input level shifters
.subckt DUT VIN VOUT VSS VREF
RFB1 VOUT FB 20k
RFB2 FB VSS 20k
CFB VOUT FB 47p
* Matched source followers move the comparator common mode down
XSR VIN VREF SR VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=32
XSF VIN FB SF VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=32
RSR SR VSS 25k
RSF SF VSS 25k
* Wide weak-inversion bias mirror
RB PB VSS 210k
XPB PB PB VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XPT TS PB VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=8
* Error amplifier
XPI1 ND SR TS VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=8
XPI2 EA SF TS VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=1 nf=1 m=8
XNL1 ND ND VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=10 nf=1 m=1
XNL2 EA ND VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=10 nf=1 m=1
* Adaptive gate driver and pass device
XDR PG EA VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=30 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XREP PG PG VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=1
XPASS VOUT PG VIN VIN sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=24
* Frequency shaping and supply feedthrough filtering
RCOMP EA CZ 200k
CCOMP CZ VSS 50p
CEA EA VSS 3p
.ends DUT
